_readme: The only place prices live. The homepage pricing block, the homepage service cards ('from £…') and the service pages all read this file. price is in pounds; set "from": true for 'from £…'; set "period": "month" for monthly prices.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.detail: Up to 5 pages, a clean design from my own design system, a contact form and basic SEO.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.summary: Up to 12 pages, custom design, full SEO
tiers.detail: Up to 12 pages, a custom design, content you can edit yourself and a full SEO setup.

tiers.name: Custom
tiers.detail: Booking, e-commerce, integrations and web apps. Quoted per project.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.detail: Up to 5 pages and 20 posts, redirects from your old addresses, and Netlify hosting set up.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.detail: Up to 12 pages and 100 posts, a contact form, plus an SEO and speed pass.

tiers.name: Large
tiers.detail: More than 12 pages or 100 posts, quoted after the audit.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.summary: Hosting, backups, monitoring, 30 min of changes
tiers.detail: Hosting, SSL, backups, uptime monitoring and 30 minutes of changes a month.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.detail: Everything in Essential, plus 2 hours of changes a month and a quarterly speed and SEO report.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.summary: 4 hours, monthly SEO and content work
tiers.detail: Everything in Standard, plus 4 hours a month and monthly SEO and content work.

notes: Care plans have a 3-month minimum, and paying annually gets you two months free. Small one-off jobs are £100 an hour (1-hour minimum) or £650 a day.
